au.csiro.JamesGunning.sulib
Class SuReader

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--au.csiro.JamesGunning.sulib.SuReader
public class SuReader
extends java.lang.Object

Basic class to get seismic traces in su format, rather like the fgettr.c suite of functions in SeismicUnix. Given a SuSegyFormat object to hold the trace, and an opened RandomAccessFile (for disk files) or FileInputStream (for stdin), traces are stuffed into the SuSegyFormat by the

fgettr(RandomAccessFile fp, SuSegyFormat tr)

or

fgettr(FileInputStream fp, SuSegyFormat tr)

calls. An example usage fragment is

FileInputStream stdin = null;
SuSegyFormat tr = new SuSegyFormat();
// get input stream (stdin)
stdin = (FileInputStream) new FileInputStream(FileDescriptor.in);
while (sureader.fgettr(stdin,tr) != 0)
{

    // do stuff with traces...
}
